sessions.title: Core Architecture & LangGraph State Machine
sessions.user_prompt: Design an end-to-end multi-agent research evaluation system where an Analyst agent gathers evidence and synthesizes answers, while an independent Auditor agent verifies every single claim against live web pages. The workflow must have a 120-second hard timeout, use LangGraph, and never invent sources or accept unverified claims.
key_decisions: Architected LangGraph StateGraph topology with 10 explicit nodes.
Enforced Information Asymmetry: Auditor operates in isolation without Analyst prompt context.
Wrapped workflow in asyncio.wait_for(timeout=120.0) for guaranteed hard time bounds.

sessions.title: Entity Memory Architecture (Anti-Caching)
sessions.user_prompt: We must implement persistent memory in SQLite for research queries across 8 progressive benchmark questions. How do we ensure this is NOT just a naive prompt/response cache? The memory must transfer entity knowledge when a subsequent question asks a new fact about the same entity.
key_decisions: Designed normalized SQLite schema with 8 relational tables (entities, sources, evidence, claims, claim_evidence, audit_results, feedback, runs).
Implemented EntityMemoryManager with get_entity_knowledge() resolving verified claims by entity.
Differentiated Memory Hits (facts found) from Memory Misses (exploratory search needed).

sessions.title: Deterministic Pre-Verification & 5-Axis Conflict Resolution
sessions.user_prompt: LLM calls for verification are expensive and can be inconsistent. Can we build zero-token deterministic Python checks that run before the LLM? Also, how do we handle conflicting numbers between sources without hallucinating?
key_decisions: Built ClaimVerifier with zero-token citation check, URL provenance, and numerical extraction.
Formulated ConflictResolver along 5 concrete axes: Geographic Scope, Accounting Period, Operational Metric (Net vs Gross), Recency, Guidance vs Actuals.

sessions.title: Auditor Agent Isolation & Operational Policy Feedback
sessions.user_prompt: Build the Auditor Agent. It must independently inspect cited pages and categorize each claim as SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, or MISSING_CITATION. If an audit fails, how does the system learn from it in future queries?
key_decisions: AuditorAgent operates at temperature 0.0 with strict 4-class classification.
Implemented closed-loop feedback storing operational rules in SQLite feedback table.
Policies are dynamically injected into future Planner and Analyst prompts.

sessions.title: Dual Web Tools & Deterministic Passage Extraction
sessions.user_prompt: Web scraping can fail if sites block standard bots. Implement a dual strategy: Tavily Extract as primary, httpx + BeautifulSoup4 as fallback. Also, raw web pages are huge. Extract only relevant paragraphs to minimize LLM token costs.
key_decisions: Created PageFetcher with primary Tavily Extract and fallback httpx+BS4.
Built EvidenceExtractor scoring passages deterministically to cut input tokens by >75%.

sessions.title: 8-Question Benchmark & Adversarial Mode Setup
sessions.user_prompt: Set up the 8 progressive research questions (Titan, Kalyan, Senco, Malabar) and run both NORMAL_ANALYST and ADVERSARIAL_ANALYST modes. Export metrics.csv, audit_results.csv, cost_trend.csv, answers.json, and summary.json.
key_decisions: Implemented app/evaluation/run_questions.py with progressive complexity.
Built ADVERSARIAL_ANALYST mode with aggressive auditing notices.
Implemented compile_evaluation_results() generating CSVs and summary JSON.

sessions.title: Live Web Search Debugging & Latency Optimization
sessions.user_prompt: When trying to search for current data in the web UI, it fails with 'No answer generated', Latency: NaN s, Tokens: 0. Solve this problem by looking into the live search.
key_decisions: Diagnosed Google GenAI Automatic Function Calling (AFC) hanging on Windows sockets for 140s; disabled AFC across all agents.
Benchmarked models: switched from queuing gemini-3.5-flash-lite to fast gemini-3.1-flash-lite (1.2s).
Added URL evidence resolution in ClaimVerifier.
Terminated stale port 8000 process holding pre-fix code.

sessions.title: Reviewer Feedback Fulfillment & 4-Class Segregation
sessions.user_prompt: Ashok review feedback: empty /logs, missing DECISIONS.md, mock vs live benchmark results. Also segregate fetched results based on strict 4-class classification: SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, MISSING_CITATION.
key_decisions: Authored comprehensive DECISIONS.md covering all 8 ADRs.
Exported full AI sessions to logs/ai_coding_sessions.md and logs/cursor_claude_sessions.json.
Executed full 8-question benchmark against live APIs, updating results/normal and results/adversarial.
Implemented 4-class segregation UI with dedicated constraint headers, count badges, and interactive filter pills.
